'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2026 Nepalese general election]]
**Partial preliminary results in [[Nepal]] indicate that the [[Rastriya Swatantra Party]] (RSP) won 60 of 165 [[first-past-the-post]] seats, while also leading in 61 other consituencies. In [[Jhapa 5 (constituency)|Jhapa 5]], RSP prime ministerial candidate [[Balen Shah]] defeats former [[Prime Minister of Nepal|prime minister]] [[K. P. Sharma Oli]]. [https://apnews.com/article/nepal-parliament-election-results-balendra-shah-aac242077d2dd052e7e9bdd7c088ccc9 (AP)] [https://thehimalayantimes.com/nepal/balen-wins-before-official-announcement-as-margin-spikes (''The Himalayan Times'')]
*[[Guinea]] dissolves 40 [[List of political parties in Guinea|political parties]] by decree, including the three main opposition groups—the [[Union of Democratic Forces of Guinea]], the [[Rally of the Guinean People]], and the [[Union of Republican Forces]]—for failing to meet legal requirements, and orders the seizure of their assets.
